records.title: Growth in Domestic production of fertilisers
details: a to d: Recently, the Union Cabinet has approved the proposal for setting up of a new Brownfield Ammonia-Urea Complex- of 12.7 Lakh Metric Tonnes (LMT) annual capacity of Urea production within the existing premises of Brahmaputra Valley Fertilizer Corporation Limited (BVFCL), Namrup, Assam. Both are under execution.

records.title: DELAY IN DOUBLING WORK FROM BIRUR TO SHIVAMOGGA RAIKWAY STATION, KARNATAKA
details: a to c: Final Location Survey (FLS) for doubling between Birur - Shivamoga (63 KM) was completed in 2016 but the project could not be taken forward due to low traffic projections. However, a fresh Final Location Survey (FLS) has been sanctioned in June, 2024 to assess the latest cost and traffic projections.
